item.tib: gtsug gtor gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub par phyir bzlog pa rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bskang bshags legs pa kun 'byung
item.coloph: ces gtsug gtor gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i bskang bshags legs pa kun 'byung 'di ni/ khro tshang bstan 'dzin nor bu'i dam pa'i snga bar gsung gis bskul yid la bcag pa dang / nye bar drung yig pa ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bskul ba la bsten nas/ kho bo kun grol grags pa can gyis bkra shis smin grol khrod du bkod pa/ shing sprel hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin du dge'o//
